svg.text: spin to the pen you want · press the button · it drops into the catch tray below
◀ fluted drum + loaded pen show through the open top
upper unit slides down into the catch-tray base
rotate the chosen chamber to the bottom drop station
push the button — the latch releases the trapdoor
the trapdoor swings open and that one pen falls
it lands in the angled tray and rolls to the front lip
Parts: fluted drum · cradle (legs+shroud+latch) · trapdoor flap · secondary catch base. Mechanism shown closed — see README for motion & tuning.
